Hi Ritika — and thanks for the quick reply.

Short answer: Tue 22:30 IST = Tue 17:00 UTC = Tue 10:00 PT (same calendar day). We triple-checked because India does not observe DST while PT/ET do — so on DST transitions you can get a 1-hour shift if invites are interpreted in local time. To avoid that, we recommend agreeing on the UTC time and putting the UTC time in the invite subject (e.g., \"Demo — 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT / 22:30 IST\").

For clarity, small conversion table (all Tue slots):
- 10:00 PT = 13:00 ET = 17:00 UTC = 22:30 IST
- 11:00 PT = 14:00 ET = 18:00 UTC = 23:30 IST
- 22:00 IST = 17:30 UTC = 10:30 PT

If your team prefers 22:00 IST specifically, that would be 17:30 UTC / 10:30 PT. We can send the invite for 17:30 UTC if you confirm. Otherwise we’ll lock 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT / 22:30 IST).

I’m looping Soojin here who runs our scheduling for APAC demos in case we need to nudge invites or add a backup slot.

Best,
Marissa
